data.name: access_token
data.description: The actual access token provided by the client in the HTTP request.

data.name: AccessToken
data.description: JSON object representing the decoded access token that was passed from the client to authorize the current HTTP request.   Most fields of the access token are consistent with those defined by RFC 7519, JSON Web Token, and/or RFC 7662, OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection.

data.name: active
data.description: Whether this access token is currently active, as determined by the access token validator of the Policy Enforcement Point.

data.name: algorithm
data.description: The name of the certificate signature algorithm.

data.name: attributesToAdd
data.description: Returns a collection of all attributes that will be added.

data.name: attributesToModify
data.description: Returns a collection of all attributes that will be modified in any way.

data.name: attributesToRemove
data.description: Returns a collection of all attributes to be removed.

data.name: attributesToReplace
data.description: Returns a collection of all attributes to be replaced.

data.name: audience
data.description: Identifies the recipient(s) that the access token is intended for.

data.name: authentication_age
data.description: The number of seconds since the end user was authenticated.

data.name: authentication_policy
data.description: Identifies the authentication policy that was satisfied when the access token was issued. An authentication policy is also called an authentication context class reference (ACR).

valueProcessor.name: Access Token Authentication Policy JSON Path Processor

data.name: authentication_time
data.description: The date and time when the end user was authenticated.

valueProcessor.name: Access Token Authentication Time JSON Path Processor

data.name: BasePath
data.description: The portion of the HTTP request URI that matches the API Endpoint's inbound-base-path value.

data.name: client_id
data.description: The client identifier of the client application that requested this token.

data.name: ClientCertificate
data.description: JSON object representing a TLS certificate presented by the HTTP client.

data.name: CorrelationId
data.description: A unique identifier attached to a request/response pair by the PingAuthorize Server.

data.name: expiration
data.description: The date and time at which the access token will expire.

data.name: Gateway
data.description: Policy attributes specific to the PingAuthorize API security gateway or Sideband API.

data.name: HttpRequest
data.description: The HTTP request or response.

data.name: id
data.description: The SCIM resource's unique identifier.

data.name: impactedAttributes
data.description: The set of attribute names that will be created or modified by the current request. This might not be available for all services.

data.name: IPAddress
data.description: The client IP address.

data.name: issued_at
data.description: The date and time at which this access token was issued.

data.name: issuer
data.description: The issuer X.500 Principal.

data.name: issuer
data.description: A string identifying the issuer of this access token.

data.name: leaf
data.description: The leaf segment of the Resource URI.

data.name: meta
data.description: An object containing metadata about the SCIM resource.

data.name: modifications
data.description: For requests with action 'modify' (i.e., PUT or PATCH requests), contains the set of changes to be made. This object uses a normalized form of the SCIM 2 PATCH request format, as described by RFC 7644, section 3.5.2.

data.name: not_before
data.description: The date and time before which the access token must not be accepted for processing.

data.name: notAfter
data.description: Expiration date/time of the certificate.

data.name: notBefore
data.description: The earliest date on which this certificate should be considered valid.

data.name: QueryParameters
data.description: A JSON object representing the query parameters, if any, that were passed with the client's HTTP request.   Each field in the object represents a parameter name, and the value of each field is a JSON array representing the parameter value(s).

data.name: RequestBody
data.description: For POST, PUT, and PATCH operations, this attribute will contain the JSON body of the HTTP request.

data.name: RequestHeaders
data.description: A JSON object representing the HTTP headers that were passed with the client's HTTP request.   Each field in the object represents a header name, and the value of each field is a JSON array representing the header value(s).

data.name: RequestURI
data.description: The complete HTTP request URI.

data.name: resource
data.description: Contains the SCIM 2 resource targeted by the current request. Not available if the current action is 'create' (POST).

data.name: ResourcePath
data.description: The path of the requested resource, relative to the base URI of the PingAuthorize endpoint that is processing the request.  For a SCIM request, an example path would be "Users/abcdef".

data.name: resourceType
data.description: The SCIM resource type.

data.name: ResponseBody
data.description: The body of the HTTP response, before it is returned to a client application.

data.name: ResponseHeaders
data.description: A JSON object representing the HTTP headers that were passed with the API server's HTTP response.   Each field in the object represents a header name, and the value of each field is a JSON array representing the header value(s).

data.name: ResponseStatus
data.description: The HTTP status code of a response returned from an API server, such as 200 or 404.

data.name: schemas
data.description: The set of schemas used by the SCIM resource.

data.name: SCIM2
data.description: Policy attributes specific to the PingAuthorize SCIM 2 REST API.

data.name: scope
data.description: The list of scopes granted to this token.

data.name: subject
data.description: The subject of the token. This will be a user identifier as set by the authorization server that issued the token.

data.name: subject
data.description: The subject X500 Principal.

data.name: subjectRegex
data.description: Regular expression that must be matched by the subject field of the certificate in order to ensure that the certificate belongs to the requesting client.

data.name: token_owner
data.description: Identifies the principal (end-user) that was mapped from the access token subject.  This will be a user identifier as determined by the PingAuthorize Server's access token validator. For SCIM users, this will be of the form <Resource Type>/<SCIM Id>, e.g. "Users/abcdef".

data.name: token_type
data.description: Type of the token as defined in Section 5.1 of OAuth 2.0 [RFC6749].

data.name: TokenOwner
data.description: If the request is authorized with a user access token, this is a JSON object representing the authenticated user that owns the access token.   Will not be present for client-credentials access tokens.  The fields of this JSON object depend upon the schema defined for the user record.

data.name: TrailingPath
data.description: The portion of the HTTP request URI that follows the _BasePath.

data.name: user_token
data.description: Whether this token was issued on behalf of a user. If false, then this token was issued to a client and does not have a specific user as its subject.

data.name: username
data.description: Human-readable identifier for the end-user principal who authorized this token.   Not present for client credentials tokens.

data.name: valid
data.description: Whether the client SSL certificate is valid.
